mode.description: clone = faithful GlassFlow reconstruction (real assets/copy allowed). generation = a new page for another brand: the semantic validator rejects every GlassFlow identity, asset, URL, claim and copy match (GENERATION_MODE_* rules).

motion.description: Closed to the real fields; patterns closed to tokens/00-foundation/motion.json.

tokens.description: Optional per-node token NAMES (tokens/llm/token-policy.json slots). Strings, not enums, so the semantic validator can name the failure (TOKEN_UNKNOWN / _RAW_VALUE / _ARBITRARY_SPACING / _UNSUPPORTED_FONT / _THEME_MISMATCH).
